newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO SIGNS SOUTH AFRICAN CREDIT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO SIGNS SOUTH AFRICAN CREDIT DEAL.

text.p: Dutch financial giant ABN AMRO said on Tuesday it had signed a framework credit agreement worth 100 million guilders with Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) in South Africa.
"The agreement...aims to finance the exports of Dutch capital goods and services to South Africa", ABN AMRO said.
IDC is a financial goverment institution, set up in order to develop private businesses and industries in South Africa.
The Dutch bank also said it would do part of the billing for Lucent Technologies which is expanding the South African telecommunications network.

Since 1995 ABN AMRO has raised its profile in South Africa by reopening a branch and leading three syndicate loans to companies in mining, telecommunications and food, raising a total 700 million guilders.
It has also arranged local credit facilities for Dutch companies.
